title: Epochal prompt-versioning and semantic-parity SLO CI gate
author: Aisha Roy
commits: feat: add epochal prompt manifest and versioning utilities
feat: implement semantic-parity scorer (embedding + token-agreement hybrid)
feat(ci): pre-merge slo gate job and backfill-run adapter
test: add cohort-driven synthetic regression fixtures and smoke runner
docs: usage guide for prompt epochs, rollbacks and backfills
description: Motivation: We need a repeatable way to track prompt-set level regressions across time windows (epochs) and a compact CI guard that prevents merges that materially degrade end-to-end quality for high-priority cohorts. This PR introduces an "epochal prompt-versioning" model for prompt sets plus a semantic-parity SLO gate that runs in pre-merge CI. What changed: 1) prompt_epoch manifest and tooling: a lightweight epoch manifest (manifest.py) and migration helper (migrate_epoch_tags.py) to tag and snapshot prompt-sets as epochs; supports automatic epoch creation via tag_current_prompts.sh. 2) semantic-parity metric: metrics/semantic_parity.py implements a hybrid score combining embedding cosine agreement, normalized token-level agreement, and a calibrated penalty for hallucination-like divergences. Score is cohort-aware and returns confidence intervals using bootstrap resampling. 3) CI pre-merge SLO gate: ci/premerge_slo_gate.yml runs a compact smoke eval that samples representative items from high_priority_cohorts.json, computes semantic-parity vs the pinned baseline epoch, and fails the job when the 3-day rolling mean parity drop for any high-priority cohort exceeds 2.5% (configurable). 4) Backfill & orchestration: orchestrator/backfill_runner.py can backfill historical epochs to compute trend signals for the first run and seed baselines; runner modifications wire the new scorer into the standard eval pipeline. 5) Tests & fixtures: new unit tests and synthetic regression fixtures to exercise boundary conditions (minor wording drift, paraphrase-preserving changes, and tokenization-induced mismatches). 6) Docs: docs/prompt_epoching.md documents processes for creating epochs, rollback guidance, and governance for pinned baselines. How it works: The semantic-parity scorer uses a two-stage pipeline: cheap embedding similarity to filter likely-paraphrase matches, then token-aligned normalized agreement with an edit-distance-derived gap penalty; results are bootstrapped to produce CI-level bounds per cohort. The pre-merge CI runs the smoke eval with a 50-example stratified sample per high-priority cohort (configurable), computes the cohort-wise parity delta, and applies a configurable smoothing window before gating. Backfill can be run in a longer job to populate historical baselines. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag: start with 'dry-run' CI behavior (warnings only) for one week, then promote to soft-fail (block merge but auto-create incident draft) for the next week, and finally enforce hard-fail gating for the high-priority cohort set. Migration: a migration helper tags the current prompt set as epoch v1; operators can run migrate_epoch_tags.py --backfill to populate historic baselines. Testing notes: unit tests added and a local smoke harness included; run ./scripts/run_local_smoke.sh --cohort high_priority to reproduce. Related tickets: ENG-3421 implemented the epoch model; PM-118 defines the SLO thresholds; SUP-9442 requested a pre-merge guard after a recent prompt regression incident. Backwards compatibility: existing eval APIs unchanged; new epoch manifest lives under eval-harness/prompt_epoch and is opt-in. Security/privacy: no training data are exported; embeddings are computed transiently with caching disabled in CI. CI: initial runs caught a flaky bootstrap seed; tests fixed by seeding and a 5-retry test harness. This PR is intentionally conservative in its gating thresholds and ships with an operator override to bypass gating during urgent rollouts.
conversation: Liam Carter (reviewer): This looks good overall. Two requests: make the cohort sample size configurable from defaults.yaml and add a short-circuit when the cohort sample returns fewer than N items so CI doesn't randomly fail.
Aisha Roy (author): Good catch — added cohort sample config to defaults.yaml and short-circuit logic in bench/cohort_sample_selector.py. Updated tests to cover small-cohort fallback.

Mariana Ortiz (reviewer): The hybrid metric is clever but I'd like a short doc blurb on calibration methodology and an example where embedding similarity disagrees with token agreement. Please add to metrics/README.md.
Aisha Roy (author): Added calibration notes and an example in metrics/README.md. Also included a small diagnostic plot generator for offline inspection.
Ethan Blake (reviewer): CI job is heavier than typical pre-merge checks. Can we ensure it reuses cached embeddings and times out gracefully?

Aisha Roy (author): CI uses a small no-cache mode by default to avoid stale results, but premerge_slo_gate.yml will run in ephemeral mode with a 90s timeout per cohort; backfill uses cache-enabled longer runs. Added explicit timeouts and retry logic.
Mariana Ortiz: Approved after docs and sample-size fix.
Liam Carter: Approved. Minor nit resolved in a follow-up patch.
Merge-Queue Bot: Merged by squash on 2025-11-20 after passing CI and approvals.
release_notes: Add epochal prompt-versioning and a cohort-aware semantic-parity pre-merge CI gate to detect prompt-set regressions. Opt-in epoch manifests, backfill tooling, and a configurable gating threshold included.
